title: auth_log_probe v1
description: The agent wrote the line "auth log probe <run_id>" to syslog with facility authpriv and tag oscompliance-agent, where the authentication log is written. When the same line comes back as a Wazuh alert (rule 119002), the authentication log of the machine reaches Wazuh, whether or not anybody logged in.

status.description: written; error (syslog could not be reached).
